title: fix(mcp): record data faces serve the /data door's declaredCode and userMessage
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1tF2sadne3zXMJh3i9wcbN)_

Fixes #31373

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的六个记录数据工具、`delete_records` 的选择读取和记录资源,在按 `/api/v1/data` 门的回答作答时,把门给出的 `declaredCode` 和 `userMessage` 也一并带上(排在 `status` 之后,门没给就不出现),和 `run_action` / `resume_run` 的写法一致。
- 为什么改:#31341 之后,应用自己未注册的码配 5xx(例如 `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503)在这些面上只剩封闭码 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`,`/data` 门却还在 `declaredCode` 里给出 `VENDOR_DOWN`;生产者标注的 `userMessage` 也被丢掉。智能体拿到的比 REST 门少。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `@objectstack/mcp`,patch。两个成员都从门的回答体里读,不另写降级规则。声明了 4xx 以下状态的带码拒绝不走门的回答,逐字节不变;元数据工具和 `list_actions` 的回答不变(新增 CONTROL 钉住)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `dataDoorAnswerOf` 和 `metaDoorErrorResult` 的返回行;`mcp-server-runtime.ts` 记录资源的 catch。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31373`,预期 14 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`dataDoorAnswerOf` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`) reads the `/api/v1/data` door's answer (`mapDataError`). It now also reads the door body's `declaredCode` and `userMessage`, each only when the door serves a non-empty string. No second demotion rule: the values are the door's.

- The six record data tools (`dataDoorErrorResult`) and `delete_records`' selection read render the door answer as before, so the two members now ride after `status`: `{ error: { code, message, status, declaredCode?, userMessage? } }`. That is `run_action` / `resume_run`'s rendering (#31271, `errorResultFromThrown`): same names, same order, omitted when absent.
- The record resource (`mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `bridgeResources`) adds them after `status` in its `{ error, code, status }` body.
- `metaDoorErrorResult` (metadata tools, `list_actions`) shares the reader, so it now renders `code`, `message` and `status` explicitly. Its answer is unchanged, and a new CONTROL pins that.

No export added; `dataDoorAnswerOf` is not on `packages/mcp/src/index.ts`, and the `@objectstack/types` import line is unchanged.

### Measured on `main` (`03533d2c`): which throws reach the door-answer path with these members

`mapDataError(v, 'task')` on the built `@objectstack/types`, and the path the faces take (door answer vs the coded envelope, per `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope`):

| Throw | Path | `/data` answer |
|---|---|---|
| `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 | door | 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `declaredCode: VENDOR_DOWN` |
| `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503, `refusal: true` | door | same, plus the sentence |
| `MY_FAULT` / 500 | door | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `declaredCode: MY_FAULT` |
| any door-path throw with `userMessage` (coded 5xx, `SQLITE_BUSY`, bare `Error`, code-less `{ status: 409 }`, code-less sandboxed abort) | door | the door's answer plus `userMessage` |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503, `SQLITE_BUSY`, `VENDOR_DOWN` with no status, bare `Error`, code-less statuses, sandboxed abort or crash | door | no `declaredCode` |
| `LEAVE_EXHAUSTED` / 409 (declared below 500) | envelope | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `declaredCode: LEAVE_EXHAUSTED` (out of scope, see below) |
| `PERMISSION_DENIED` (no status) with `userMessage` | envelope | 403, plus `userMessage` (out of scope, see below) |

So `declaredCode` reaches these faces for an unregistered code with a declared 5xx, and `userMessage` for any door-path throw that carries one. A code-less throw never gets a `declaredCode` from the door (there is no code to demote).

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`:

- Record data tools (#31273 block): #31341's `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 row on `update_record` **moved** and became one row per face (7): exactly `{ code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Internal server error', status: 503, declaredCode: 'VENDOR_DOWN' }`, key order pinned, equal to the door's answer, the sentence absent, one `[5xx] 503 tools/call TOOL vendor_task — ` operator line with the sentence. The rows read the object `vendor_task` so their line is the first `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` capability-absence report on its route (`logServerFault` reports that family once per route per process, as at the door).
- `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 with `userMessage` on every face: both members, in `run_action`'s order, equal to the door's.
- A code-less fault and a code-less sandboxed abort with `userMessage` on the six tools: the door's `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` and `400 HOOK_ABORTED`, each with `userMessage`. `delete_records`' catch keeps its own rendering for a code-less throw (#31246), so it is not in this row.
- CONTROL: `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503 carries no `declaredCode` and no `userMessage` on any face.
- Record resource, new #31373 block: the `VENDOR_DOWN` body with `declaredCode`, logged once on a fresh record URI; `userMessage` after `declaredCode`, and after `status` on a code-less fault; CONTROL for `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503.
- Metadata tools (#31272 block): CONTROL, `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 with `userMessage` keeps `{ code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Internal server error', status: 503 }` on all four.
- Unchanged and green: `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 and the coded sandboxed refusal on every face and on the resource, #31246's byte-for-byte CONTROL.

<details><summary>Red first and ablations</summary>

Red first on `03533d2c` (`main`), the new pins in place and no fix: `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` gave `Tests 11 failed | 154 passed (165)`: the 7 per-face `VENDOR_DOWN` rows, the two `userMessage` tool rows, and the two resource rows. Every CONTROL passed. The metadata CONTROL, added after, passes on `main` and with the fix (`166 passed`).

Ablations via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head; each printed `ok mutation landed` and then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (31cfe9000bac) and git diff HEAD is empty`:

1. The `declaredCode` member deleted from `dataDoorAnswerOf`. Blob `31cfe9000bac -> 9d6f5ee51eae`, `Tests 10 failed | 156 passed (166)`: the 7 per-face rows, the tool `userMessage` row (it asserts both members), and the two resource rows.
2. The `userMessage` member deleted. Blob `31cfe9000bac -> f5974c669fdb`, `Tests 3 failed | 163 passed (166)`: the two tool `userMessage` rows and the resource `userMessage` row.
3. `metaDoorErrorResult` put back to `codedErrorResult(door)`. Blob `31cfe9000bac -> 06f1b65913eb`, `Tests 1 failed | 165 passed (166)`: the metadata CONTROL.

A first attempt at ablations 1 and 2 used an empty `--replacement`, which the tool refused (`replacement count moved 0 -> 0`) and restored; they were re-run with `--delete`. The tests import the package's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, measured:** a coded throw with a declared status below 500 keeps its coded envelope here (#31246), so an unregistered `LEAVE_EXHAUSTED` / 409 answers `code: LEAVE_EXHAUSTED` on these faces where `/data` answers `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `declaredCode: LEAVE_EXHAUSTED`. A status-less code the door refuses (`PERMISSION_DENIED`) also renders the envelope, which drops a `userMessage` the door serves. Neither is changed, per the order.
- **`delete_records`' catch** renders a code-less throw as its bare message (#31218, #31246), so a code-less `userMessage` does not reach that face; only its coded door-path throws do.
- **The metadata tools** read the same reader with no object. They keep their answer; whether `/meta` serves these members is not measured here.
- **`Clause-②: no`, re-declared from measurement.** No export added or changed. The MCP tool error already declares `declaredCode` and `userMessage` (`codedErrorResult`), and `run_action` serves them; these faces now serve them where the door does.
- **Serial constraint:** #31330 (action path) may touch `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`; whichever lands second merges `origin/main` once.
